name: Feature request
about: A new capability or a change in behaviour
labels: enhancement
---

<!--
How to fill this in (people and agents alike):
- Write for someone who hasn't seen the conversation. Plain words, short bullets.
- Delete a section that doesn't apply instead of writing "N/A". Keep the order.
- Describe the problem and the behaviour you want, not the code. Solutions go under "For discussion".
- Title: the outcome as a sentence (`Let users export a result as PDF`).
- Checkboxes: [x] means it was actually done, and it says what it showed.
  [ ] means someone still has to do it. Never tick what didn't happen.
-->

Related: <!-- links: related issues, a design doc, a chat thread, a spec in docs/specs/. -->

## Why

<!--
The problem as a user or operator sees it today, and what it costs.
Who has it, how often, and what they do instead.
-->

## What changes

<!--
One bullet per behaviour, led by the area it touches (e.g. **Backend:**, **UI:**, **Infra:**, **CI:**).
Name new endpoints, screens, statuses and config keys exactly.
End with **Not changing:** for anything someone might assume changes.
-->

## For discussion

<!--
Decisions to agree on before building: options with their trade-offs, open questions,
a simpler version that would do. Say which option you'd pick and why.
-->

## Deploy impact

<!-- Keep only the lines that apply. -->

- **Breaks:** <!-- anything that stops working without action: a changed API contract, a required config key, existing data -->
- **Config or secrets:** <!-- keys or secrets that must be added, and where -->
- **Cost or performance:** <!-- cloud cost, latency, memory, API or token usage -->

## Done when

- [ ] <!-- Observable behaviour: "a user can do X and sees Y". -->
- [ ] <!-- What proves it: a test, a before/after number, a screenshot. -->

## Out of scope

<!-- What this deliberately leaves out, and what adding it later would take. -->
